throughput.notes: Data-dependent. CPI ranges 6 to 18 over the same operand pairs; the stored experiment uses 4294967295/1.

notes: Vector variable-latency divide/modulo. Latency 10-34 cycles and throughput CPI 6-18 are data-dependent. 32-bit lanes are not divided fully in parallel: with one slow lane the latency is 22 (vdiv.w) / 21 (xvdiv.w), and as soon as two or more lanes need many quotient bits the divider costs roughly one extra pass, giving ~32 (vdiv.w) / ~31 (xvdiv.w); the number of slow lanes beyond two does not change it further (8 slow lanes measure 31). The recorded cycles_max reflects that multi-slow-lane case. 64-bit lanes, by contrast, are fully parallel and only the slowest lane matters. Re-derived with the two-cycle cross-domain calibration: movfr2gr and movgr2fr are 2 cycles each, movgr2frh.w is 3, the flag pair is 7/15, vpickve2gr is 3, xvpickve2gr is 5, and vreplgr2vr/xvreplgr2vr are 2 (3 for the byte and half-word broadcast).
